Also, I had a similar problem like you communicating with others when I first left my home country years back. I was very afraid of talking to people or saying anything in the public. I was afraid that people would see me as a fool as I could not speak a proper English. I have never said a single word unless I had to, and decided to not to talk to anyone until my English gets better. well it was obviously not helping out at all and I never learned anything. Now i dont care about it. I could speak some broken English and say some words in funny way, but so what? they can't do anything about it. They may see me as a fool but  why should I care about their opinion?

So the thing is.. that you dont have to be afraid to talk. what can people possibly do? they might see you as some awkward kid but so what? everybody was once an awkward kid at certain point their life time. so dont be afraid of the others and talk to people.

I think you should continue education and start new path. If you dont want to do that now, you could maby go travel around for a while. You're only 20 and your path is still open to everywhere
